rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose choice for bearing or enduring something unpleasant.

example.english: I really can't tolerate this kind of noise.
example.traditional: 我真係忍受唔到呢種噪音。
example.jyutping: ngo5 zan1 hai6 jan2 sau6 m4 dou3 ni1 zung2 cou3 jam1

rows.note: Use this when allowing bad behavior or wrongdoing to continue without approving of it.

example.english: We can't tolerate him bullying newcomers like that.
example.traditional: 我哋唔可以容忍佢咁樣蝦新人。
example.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 m4 ho2 ji5 jung4 jan2 keoi5 gam3 joeng2 haa1 san1 jan4
